title: Entity Framework Core
description: A modern ORM for .NET that enables developers to work with a database using .NET objects.

data.text: Entity Framework Core (EF Core) is a modern object-relational mapper (ORM) for .NET. It enables developers to work with a database using .NET objects, eliminating the need for most data-access code.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install the EF Core packages for SQL Server.
data.code:
dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore
dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer
dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools

data.title: Defining a Model and DbContext
data.content: Define a simple entity and DbContext.

terms.definition: The main class that coordinates EF Core functionality for a data model.
Represents a table in the database and enables CRUD operations.
A way to incrementally update the database schema to match the data model.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use `dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate` to scaffold a migration after defining your model.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: EF Core is a code-first ORM for .NET
DbContext manages database connections and operations
DbSet provides query and save capabilities
data.takeaway: EF Core simplifies data access by mapping .NET objects to database tables.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Create a simple EF Core model with Blog and Post entities.
steps: Add EF Core and SQL Server packages
Run migrations to create the database
data.expectedOutcome: A working EF Core setup with a Blog and Post table in SQL Server.
